covers: calls of tools defined with groundedTool or controlTool, and the nested calls a grounded composite's code makes with state.invokeTool, while it runs, to a tool it lists that is defined with plain defineTool, carries a binding record (its ai.synapti/acs annotation) and is registered with registerTools as the tool the runtime runs under that name
does_not_cover: other calls of tools defined with plain defineTool, a call the runtime runs under a name a composite lists for a grounded tool included; provider-executed tools; writes made by effects, hooks, handlers or endpoints
scope: one thread (threadId), executions ordered by the runtime
boundaries: a call outside an execution authorises nothing
concurrency_note: the runtime runs one execution of a thread at a time, and serially() orders the checks of one realm
host_gaps: A call that state.invokeTool() runs in another JavaScript realm is not serialised or attributed

A nested call is covered only when it consumes the composite's nesting token: a runtime that changes the arguments before the nested tool sees them (a default, a key stripped), or runs it in a new execution, makes the call ask its own approval and checkpoint; the destination policies and output rules of the profiles of each composite with a pending invocation of the tool still apply to it, and to any other call of the tool made at that moment
Other code that calls a listed tool with exactly the arguments of a pending invocation, at the same moment, can take that invocation's one covered call
The thread's key-value store is writable by any code in the thread

The layer cannot read the runtime's tool registry: registerTools is the deployment's statement of which tool the runtime runs under each name. A nested call of a listed plain tool runs only under a name registered as that tool, an invocation of a name registered as another tool than the one listed is refused, and so is one of a name not registered while a destination policy is in force (the layer's, one of the profiles given to the composite or to a composite enclosing it, or one of the profiles given to the listed tool or to a tool it invokes, transitively); with no such policy, a name not registered that a composite lists for a grounded tool is invoked, and a tool defined with plain defineTool that the runtime runs under it is not covered

The runtime parses a call's arguments with JSON.parse before the tool sees them: an integer literal beyond ±2^53 reaches the binding rounded, and it checks and digests the rounded value, which is also what the tool runs with
